data.title: GenFleet’s KRAS G12D Lung Cancer Drug Shows Strong Phase II Results, Advancing to First Global Phase III Trial
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Genfleet Therapeutics (Shanghai), Inc. Class H ( (HK:2595) ).

GenFleet Therapeutics reported updated Phase II results for its oral KRAS G12D inhibitor GFH375 in pretreated non-small cell lung cancer, showing strong efficacy in a heavily metastatic patient population and manageable safety at a 600 mg once-daily dose. The data, presented at the 2026 World Conference on Lung Cancer, underpin GFH375’s Breakthrough Therapy Designation in China and support progression into the world’s first Phase III study of an oral KRAS G12D inhibitor in NSCLC.

The study showed objective response and disease control rates above 50% and 90% respectively, with median progression-free survival approaching or exceeding eight months and a 12-month overall survival rate of 77% among all patients, while identifying higher-grade toxicities in those recently exposed to immune checkpoint inhibitors. These results strengthen GenFleet’s competitive position in targeted lung cancer treatments, validate its RAS-focused strategy, and enhance the value of its global development partnership with Verastem, which holds commercialization rights for GFH375 outside China.
